oe_rw_assim_dacia_location = { OR = { area = area:moldavia_area area = area:wallachia_area area = area:transylvania_area } }

oe_rw_assim_dacia_territory_ready = {
    oe_rw_assim_dacia_total > 0
    oe_rw_assim_dacia_owned >= oe_rw_assim_dacia_required
}

oe_rw_dacia_romanization_started = {
    culture:oe_moldova_greek_culture = {
        OR = {
            any_movement_in_culture = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_dacia_identity_movement }
            has_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
        }
    }
}

    oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes
    custom_tooltip = { text = OE_RW_ASSIM_DACIA_NOT_STARTED NOT = { oe_rw_dacia_romanization_started = yes } }
